description: Open redirect occurs when app redirects to user-supplied URL without validation, allowing phishing.

testing: Test with https://evil.com, //evil.com, /%09/evil.com, check if redirects to evil.com via Location header
methodology.evidence: Request with evil.com returns 302 with Location: https://evil.com, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with external URL, confirm redirect

remediation: Allow list for redirect URLs, validate param
